.github/actions/setup-home-webp/action.y.before:
name: Setup home WebP codecs
description: Install hash-verified WebP 1.6.0 for home collectors
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - name: Restore pinned WebP tools
      id: webp-cache
      uses: actions/cache@v5
      with:
        path: ${{ runner.temp }}/webp-tools
        key: webp-1.6.0-ubuntu-24.04-e4ab7009bf0629fd

    - name: Install image codec dependencies
      shell: bash
      run: |
        sudo apt-get update
        sudo apt-get install --no-install-recommends --yes libjpeg-dev libpng-dev

    - name: Build verified WebP 1.6.0
      if: steps.webp-cache.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
      shell: bash
      run: |
        curl --fail --silent --show-error --location --max-time 60 https://storage.googleapis.com/downloads.webmproject.org/releases/webp/libwebp-1.6.0.tar.gz --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/libwebp.tar.gz"
        echo "e4ab7009bf0629fd11982d4c2aa83964cf244cffba7347ecd39019a9e38c4564  $RUNNER_TEMP/libwebp.tar.gz" | sha256sum --check
        tar -xzf "$RUNNER_TEMP/libwebp.tar.gz" -C "$RUNNER_TEMP"
        cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/libwebp-1.6.0"
        ./configure --prefix="$RUNNER_TEMP/webp-tools" --disable-shared --enable-static --disable-sdl --disable-gl
        make -j2
        make install

    - name: Enable verified WebP tools
      shell: bash
      run: |
        echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/webp-tools/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
        test "$("$RUNNER_TEMP/webp-tools/bin/cwebp" -version | head -1)" = "1.6.0"
        "$RUNNER_TEMP/webp-tools/bin/dwebp" -version

.github/workflows/home-performance-check.before:
name: Verify home performance candidate

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - 'codex/home-performance-verification-*'
      - 'codex/node-security-*'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  verify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
      - name: Verify supported Node.js runtime
        run: node scripts/check-node-version.mjs

      - name: Verify official runtime bootstrap
        run: bash scripts/deploy-cloudflare.sh --verify-only

      - name: Setup pinned WebP codecs
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-home-webp
      - name: Install pinned test dependencies
        run: |
          npm install --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/home-test-deps" --no-save --ignore-scripts playwright@1.62.1 sharp@0.35.5 xml-js@1.6.11
          echo "NODE_PATH=$RUNNER_TEMP/home-test-deps/node_modules" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          node "$RUNNER_TEMP/home-test-deps/node_modules/playwright/cli.js" install --with-deps chromium
          NODE_PATH="$RUNNER_TEMP/home-test-deps/node_modules" node -e 'console.log("CHROME_EXECUTABLE="+require("playwright").chromium.executablePath())' >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Verify codecs and build
        run: |
          node --version
          cwebp -version
          dwebp -version
          node scripts/build-site.mjs
          node scripts/check-home-recovery.mjs capture dist "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-assets.json"
          node scripts/check-home-recovery.mjs verify dist "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-assets.json"
      - name: Run fixtures and browser regression tests without publishing data
        run: |
          node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/*.test.mjs > "$RUNNER_TEMP/home-performance-tests.txt" 2>&1
          cat "$RUNNER_TEMP/home-performance-tests.txt"
          git diff --exit-code
      - name: Save verification report
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v6
        with:
          name: home-performance-verification
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/home-performance-tests.txt
            ${{ runner.temp }}/release-assets.json
          if-no-files-found: ignore

.github/workflows/update-youtube-latest..before:
name: Update home latest data

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    - cron: "10 */4 * * *"

permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: home-latest-update
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  update-youtube-latest:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          ref: main
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version

      - name: Verify supported Node.js runtime
        run: node scripts/check-node-version.mjs

      - name: Setup pinned WebP codecs
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-home-webp

      - name: Collect and validate isolated updates
        id: collect
        env:
          YOUTUBE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.YOUTUBE_API_KEY }}
          YOUTUBE_CHANNEL_ID: ${{ vars.YOUTUBE_CHANNEL_ID || 'UCdnf6zMzSdZuvUxS-CS2REQ' }}
          YOUTUBE_HANDLE: ${{ vars.YOUTUBE_HANDLE || '@えりぬい' }}
          YOUTUBE_MAX_RESULTS: "6"
          NOTE_RSS_URL: "https://note.com/erinui/rss"
          NOTE_MAX_RESULTS: "6"
          SUZURI_ACCESS_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SUZURI_ACCESS_TOKEN }}
          SUZURI_USER_NAME: "erikanuinui"
          SUZURI_MAX_RESULTS: "6"
        run: node scripts/update-home-latest.mjs --report "$RUNNER_TEMP/home-update-result.json"

      - name: Save validated home data
        id: save
        run: node scripts/update-home-latest.mjs --publish --report "$RUNNER_TEMP/home-update-result.json"

      - name: Report final retrieval and save status
        if: always()
        run: node scripts/update-home-latest.mjs --finish --report "$RUNNER_TEMP/home-update-result.json" --saved "${{ steps.save.outcome }}"

    archive="node-v${version}-${platform}.tar.gz"
    ;;
  *) echo 'Unsupported runtime installation platform.' >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
if [[ $# -gt 1 || ( $# -eq 1 && "$1" != '--verify-only' && "$1" != '--preview' ) ]]; then
  echo 'Usage: deploy-cloudflare.sh [--verify-only|--preview]' >&2
  exit 1
fi
runtime_dir="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/inutaro-node-runtime.XXXXXX")"
trap 'rm -rf "$runtime_dir"' EXIT
curl --fail --silent --show-error --location --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 \
  --retry 3 --max-time 120 "https://nodejs.org/dist/v${version}/${archive}" \
  --output "$runtime_dir/$archive"
if command -v sha256sum >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  actual="$(sha256sum "$runtime_dir/$archive")"
else
  actual="$(shasum -a 256 "$runtime_dir/$archive")"
fi
if [[ "${actual%% *}" != "$expected" ]]; then
  echo 'Official Node.js archive checksum mismatch; stopping before execution.' >&2
  exit 1
fi
echo "Official Node.js ${version} ${platform} SHA-256 verified."
tar -xf "$runtime_dir/$archive" -C "$runtime_dir"
export PATH="$runtime_dir/node-v${version}-${platform}/bin:$PATH"
node scripts/check-node-version.mjs
if [[ "${1:-}" == '--verify-only' ]]; then
  echo 'Verified Node.js runtime installation; deployment was not requested.'
  exit 0
fi
if [[ "${1:-}" == '--preview' ]]; then
  npx --yes wrangler preview
else
  npx --yes wrangler deploy
fi
